messages:
Lina Chen: Quick sync — Meridian's legal/procurement reviewed the renewal and said they're ready to sign pending: vendor code on the invoice, PO submitted, and an SSO assurance clause in the contract. They also asked if we can shorten to 9 months instead of 12 with prorated pricing. Link to current redline: https://docsend.example/meridian-renewal :eyes:
Ash Patel: Great — thanks Lina. Do we have the final list price + discount for 9mo vs 12mo? need numbers to confirm with them today.
Lina Chen: On current terms: list = $180k ARR (annualized). For 9mo pro-rata we suggested 10% off on the term to keep ARR-neutral for them: roughs -> 9mo invoice = $121,500 if we do 10% term concession.
Ken Morales: From finance POV net60 is fine only if they provide a PO with vendor code and legal entity. Without PO we can't offer net60; default is CC or wire.
Sophie R.: The SSO language they're asking for is standard — we need the specific identity provider listed (Okta/Azure). We can add an SSO appendix rather than changing core T&Cs. Will prepare a redline.
Lina Chen: They said they use Okta. I'll get their vendor code and PO contact. Can we get a PO template?
Matt O'Neill: Re rev rec: if they want 9mo but pay upfront, revenue recognition is straightforward. If they want monthly invoicing over 9mo we need to flag deferred revenue. Either works; sync with finance on which cash flow they prefer.
Ash Patel: If we do a 10% concession for 9mo, does that require approval from sales lead? @Ken Morales are we comfortable with margin hit?
Ken Morales: 10% on that ARR is okay as long as it's a one-off and they sign within the quarter. Approve from finance side.
Lina Chen: Sharing a quick PO template they asked for — please confirm fields match our billing system:
```
PO Number: __
Billing Entity: Redwood Inference, Inc.
Vendor Code: __
Contract Term: 9 months
Invoice Frequency: One-time / Monthly (circle)
Payment Terms: Net60
Amount: $121,500
Contact: billing@meridian.example
```
Ash Patel: I'll tell the customer we can do 9mo with 10% off, require PO with vendor code for Net60. Also mention we can add SSO appendix (Okta) — Sophie to send redline.
Sophie R.: Uploaded redline to docsend: https://docsend.example/meridian-redline-v2 — added an SSO appendix and minimal security attestation. No risky legal exposure.
RenewalBot: Reminder set: follow up in 48h if PO not received — thread will be pinged.
Lina Chen: Customer rep (CFO) said they'll route PO today but asks if Docusign can show the appendix before signature. Can we publish the final doc to DocuSign with the appendix?
Matt O'Neill: Docusign flow fine. If they sign with PO attached, finance can accept net60. Please attach PO to the envelope.
Ash Patel: Sending customer note now — will paste snippet: "Thanks — we can do 9 months at a 10% term concession. Please send PO with vendor code and we'll send DocuSign including the SSO appendix. Net60 accepted with PO attached."
Lina Chen: Customer replied: "PO routed, vendor code XMER-775, expect PO PDF in ~2 hours." :raised_hands:
Ken Morales: Once PO received, billing team will kick off invoice creation. CC myself if any vendor code mismatches.
Sophie R.: After PO and signed DocuSign, I'll close the legal task.
Lina Chen: Thanks team — marking this as in-flight. Will update when PO/email received and when DocuSign sent.
RenewalBot: Thread status -> in_progress. Next reminder in 48h.
